Dash_ServiceMissing: Not running: system folders can't be cleaned and app launches aren't counted. Reinstall with install.ps1.
Dash_ServicePortable: The portable edition has no background service: user cleanup, data moving, usage stats and priority still work. System folders aren't cleaned and app launches aren't counted; use the installer for full features.
Clean_ScanResult: About {size} can be freed. Nothing is deleted until you click "Clean selected".
Clean_ConfirmRun:
Clean these items?{rules}

Files currently open by apps are skipped.
Clean_Result: Freed {size}: deleted {deleted} files, skipped {failed} files in use.
Clean_SystemNeedsService: (Background service not running, system items skipped.)
Clean_ReviewRequired:
These items need their file list reviewed before cleaning:{rules}

Click "Scan (dry run)", then "View files" on each item and untick the files you want to keep.
Clean_AutoSkipsReview: Automatic cleanup and "Clean now" skip "review first" items; those are only cleaned here after reviewing their files.
Review_Note: This item may contain app data that is still needed. Untick files you want to keep; only ticked files are deleted.
Sug_Note: These are suggestions only: nothing is deleted automatically. Selected files go to the Recycle Bin and can be restored.
Sug_Roots: Folders to scan (one per line, %USERPROFILE% allowed):
Sug_ConfirmRecycle: Move {count} files ({size}) to the Recycle Bin?
Sug_Recycled: Moved {count} files ({size}) to the Recycle Bin.
Sug_LastAccessOff: Windows has last-access timestamps turned off, so "not used" is based on the last modified date.
Reloc_Intro: Move app data (Zalo, Telegram, browsers…) to another drive. The path on drive C stays the same through a junction, so apps keep working. The original is kept as a backup so you can undo.
Reloc_ConfirmMove:
Move
{path} ({size})
to {target}?

These apps must be closed: {apps}.
Reloc_AppsRunning: Running: {apps}. Close them to continue? (Save your work first.)
Reloc_CloseFailed: Couldn't close {apps}. Quit the app (including its tray icon) and try again.
Reloc_DoneHint: Open the app to check it. The original is still there (.mwbak); after a few days of normal use, click "Delete backup" to reclaim space on drive C.
Reloc_Failed: Error: {error}. Click "Resume" after fixing it, or "Undo" to restore.
Reloc_ConfirmRollback: Move the data back to {path} and remove the junction?
Reloc_ConfirmDeleteBackup: Delete backup {path}? After this the data only exists on the target drive.
Reloc_BackupDue: Backup {path} has been kept for over {days} days. If the app works fine, delete it in "Move app data".
Reloc_HealthIssue: Data folder {path} has a problem: {problem}. Don't open that app until it's fixed.
Reloc_RollbackAllResult: Undid {ok} folders, {failed} failed. See logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\ManagerWindows\logs.
Problem_SourceAlreadyLinked: This folder has already been moved.
Problem_SameVolume: Target is on the same drive as the source; pick another drive.
Problem_TargetNotNtfs: Target drive must be NTFS (junctions only work on NTFS).
Problem_TargetNotFixed: Target must be an internal drive (no USB/network drives: unplugging would break the app).
Problem_NotEnoughSpace: Not enough space on the target drive (1 GB spare required).
Problem_TargetInsideSource: Target folder is inside the source folder.
Usage_Hourly: Computer usage by hour of day
Usage_NoLaunches: Launch counts need the background service running.
Prio_Intro: Priority apps get CPU first when the computer is busy. Background apps are lowered and run in efficiency mode (EcoQoS). Original levels are restored when you turn this off or exit.
Prio_TopN: Automatically prioritize the most used apps (7 days):
Prio_AllowHigh: Allow High priority for pinned apps (default is Above normal only)
Excel_Enabled: Detect heavy Excel files: prioritize Excel, lower browsers/Zalo/OneDrive
Excel_Threshold: Heavy when the file is larger than (MB):
Excel_Heavy: Excel has a heavy file open: {file} · RAM {ram} · CPU {cpu}%. Excel is being prioritized.
Excel_HeavyNotify: Excel has a heavy file open: {file}. Excel is being prioritized. Click for tips to make the file lighter.
Excel_HeavyNotifyUnknown: Excel is using a lot of resources and is being prioritized. Click to analyze the file.
ExcelS_Office32Bit: Office on this PC is 32-bit and can only use about 2–4 GB of RAM. Reinstall 64-bit Office to open large files without freezing or out-of-memory errors.
ExcelS_LowMemory: Only {percent}% of RAM is free. Close browsers/other apps or add more RAM.
ExcelS_SaveAsXlsb: File is {size} MB: saving as Excel Binary (.xlsb) is usually 30–50% smaller and noticeably faster to open/save (File > Save As > Excel Binary Workbook).
ExcelS_OldXlsFormat: The old .xls format is limited to 65,536 rows and slow. Save it as .xlsx or .xlsb.
ExcelS_GhostUsedRange: Sheet "{sheet}" has a used range of {range}, far larger than its real data (whole rows/columns formatted). Select the empty rows/columns after the data → Delete them, then save.
ExcelS_ManyConditionalFormats: Sheet "{sheet}" has {count} conditional formatting ranges. Merge or remove some (Home > Conditional Formatting > Manage Rules).
ExcelS_VolatileFormulas: {count} formulas use volatile functions (INDIRECT, OFFSET, NOW, TODAY, RAND…), forcing a full recalculation on every edit. Replace them with INDEX/XLOOKUP or fixed values.
ExcelS_ManualCalculation: The file has {count} formulas. Switch to manual calculation while entering data: Formulas > Calculation Options > Manual, press F9 to recalculate.
ExcelS_TooManyStyles: The file has {count} cell styles (normally a few hundred). Remove excess styles with Inquire > Clean Excess Cell Formatting or copy the data into a new workbook.
ExcelS_ExternalLinks: The file links to {count} other files, which slows opening: Data > Edit Links > Break Link if updates aren't needed.
ExcelS_LargeImages: {count} images totaling {size} MB. Compress them: select a picture > Picture Format > Compress Pictures.
ExcelS_ManyPivotCaches: {count} pivot caches. Let PivotTables share one data source to reduce size.
ExcelS_UsePowerQuery: Very large data: load it with Power Query into the Data Model (Power Pivot) instead of keeping it on sheets.
ExcelS_DisableAddins: Disable unused add-ins: File > Options > Add-ins > COM Add-ins.
ExcelS_DisableHardwareAcceleration: Weak graphics card: File > Options > Advanced > check "Disable hardware graphics acceleration".
Set_StartWithWindows: Start when signing in to Windows
Set_Privacy: All data (statistics, history) stays on this computer and is never sent anywhere.
Dash_Subtitle: Drives, space cleaned and what to do next
Dash_NoAppsToday: No app usage recorded today yet.
Act_RelocBroken: {count} moved data folders have a broken junction. Don't open those apps until fixed.
Act_ServiceMissing: Background service isn't running, so system folders aren't cleaned. Reinstall with install.cmd.
Act_BackupDue: {count} backups ({size}) have been kept long enough and can be deleted.
Act_NeverCleaned: No cleanup yet. Run a scan to see how much can be freed.
Clean_Subtitle: Scan first; nothing is deleted until you click Clean
Usage_Subtitle: Real active time per app, idle time excluded
Set_ThemeDesc: "Same as Windows" follows the light/dark setting in Windows Settings.
Instance_CloseFailed: Couldn't close the running copy. Right-click the Manager Windows tray icon > Exit, then open this one again.
Prio_PickDesc: One row per app (all child processes combined, e.g. Chrome's many processes). Choose "Prioritize" so the app gets CPU first, "Lower" for background apps. Changes are saved and applied immediately.
Prio_AddLabel: Add an app that isn't open:
Prio_AddHint: Process name, e.g. EXCEL, chrome, WINWORD
Proc_Subtitle: Which apps use CPU and RAM; end tasks, free memory, watch background apps
Proc_FreeMemoryHint: Make every app release the RAM it holds and empty Windows' standby cache. Apps reload what they need; to free memory for good, end apps you don't use.
Proc_ConfirmEnd:
End {app} ({count} processes)?

Unsaved data in the app will be lost.
Proc_Protected: {app} is a system process and can't be ended.
Proc_EndPartial: Ended {count} processes of {app}; {failed} couldn't be ended (needs the background service or admin rights).
Proc_TrimmedApp: Freed {size} of RAM from {app}. It reloads what it needs when used.
Proc_TrimmedAppPartial: Freed {size} of RAM from {app}; {failed} processes need more rights.
Proc_StandbySkipped: Standby cache not emptied (needs the installed edition's background service).
Proc_AlertsEnabled: Alert when background apps use a lot of resources
Proc_IgnoredHint: Process names, one per line or comma-separated. Right-click a row to add quickly.
Proc_AlertCpuMsg: {app} is running in the background using {cpu}% CPU for {sec} seconds. Open Processes to inspect or end it.
Proc_AlertRamMsg: {app} is running in the background using {ram} of RAM. Open Processes to free memory or end it.
Proc_DiskHint: Active time of the busiest physical disk (as in Task Manager). Near 100% for long makes the PC stutter and apps open slowly.
Proc_IoHint: Read + write rate of the app. Includes network/device I/O (like Task Manager's I/O column), so it approximates disk usage.
Lag_Title: The PC may be slow because:
Lag_Memory: RAM {percent}% used, Windows is paging to disk. Top users: {apps}.
Lag_NoApp: no single app (likely Windows itself or a driver)
